task.title: Filter Replacement
task.shortdesc: Replacing filters at the correct interval maintains airflow efficiency.

ul.li: When airflow drops below 80% of optimal

step.cmd: Shut down the machine and disconnect power.

info.p: Never change filters while the machine is running or connected to power.

step.cmd: Open the main filter access panel.

info.p: Dispose of the old filter according to local environmental regulations.

step.cmd: Clean the filter housing using a vacuum.
Install the new filter element, ensuring proper alignment.
Restart the machine and verify normal airflow.
